scope.support_note: No versioned support line is declared yet; embedding projects should pin an engine revision.
included: project cache options declared during the Init stage
ordered project-generation stage entrypoints and hooks
excluded: package declaration grammar and payload layouts
toolchain files and platform preset policy

option_override_precedence: SetOption value supplied by the embedding project

options.name: FO_MAIN_CONFIG
options.description: Path to the embedding project's main .fomain configuration file.

options.name: FO_DEV_NAME
options.description: Short project identifier used as the generated target and binary prefix.

options.name: FO_NICE_NAME
options.description: Human-readable project name used by generated applications and packages.

options.name: FO_GEOMETRY
options.description: World-grid geometry mode.

options.name: FO_MAP_HEX_WIDTH
options.description: Map cell width in pixels.

options.name: FO_MAP_HEX_HEIGHT
options.description: Map cell height in pixels.

options.name: FO_MAP_CAMERA_ANGLE
options.description: Map camera angle in degrees.

options.name: FO_APP_ICON
options.description: Application icon source used by generated platform targets.

options.name: FO_OUTPUT_PATH
options.description: Common root for generated binaries, packages, baking data, and validation output.

options.name: FO_CXX_STANDARD
options.description: C++ language standard used for project compilation; values below 20 are unsupported.

options.name: FO_BINARY_OUTPUT_POSTFIX
options.description: Optional postfix appended to generated binary output directory names.

options.name: FO_EMBEDDED_DATA_CAPACITY
options.description: Capacity reserved for embedded data in generated binaries.

options.name: FO_INTERNAL_CONFIG_CAPACITY
options.description: Capacity reserved for embedded internal configuration data.

options.name: FO_EFFECT_SCRIPT_VALUES
options.description: Number of float slots in ScriptValueBuf; the value must be a multiple of four.

options.name: FO_EFFECT_MAX_PASSES
options.description: Maximum number of passes in one effect.

options.name: FO_MODEL_LAYERS_COUNT
options.description: Number of model rendering layers compiled into the engine shape contract.

options.name: FO_MODEL_MAX_TEXTURES
options.description: Maximum number of textures available to one 3D model.

options.name: FO_MODEL_MAX_BONES
options.description: Maximum number of bone matrices available to one 3D model.

options.name: FO_MODEL_BONES_PER_VERTEX
options.description: Number of bone influences compiled into each 3D model vertex.

options.name: FO_MSAN_LIBCXX_ROOT
options.description: Install prefix of an MSan-instrumented libc++ used by San_Memory configurations.

options.name: FO_MSAN_IGNORELIST
options.description: MemorySanitizer ignorelist path.

options.name: FO_RESHARPER_SETTINGS
options.description: Optional ReSharper solution settings file copied during finalization.

options.name: FO_ENABLE_3D
options.description: Compile support for 3D models.

options.name: FO_SPARK_PARTICLES
options.description: Compile the SPARK particle baker, runtime backend, and Mapper authoring tools.

options.name: FO_EFFEKSEER_PARTICLES
options.description: Compile the Effekseer project compiler and runtime backend.

options.name: FO_NATIVE_SCRIPTING
options.description: Compile the Native scripting backend.

options.name: FO_ANGELSCRIPT_SCRIPTING
options.description: Compile the AngelScript scripting backend.

options.name: FO_MONO_SCRIPTING
options.description: Compile the Mono scripting backend.

options.name: FO_DISABLE_RPMALLOC
options.description: Disable the bundled rpmalloc allocator.

options.name: FO_DISABLE_MONGO
options.description: Disable MongoDB backend support.

options.name: FO_DISABLE_SQLITE
options.description: Disable SQLite backend support.

options.name: FO_DISABLE_ASIO
options.description: Disable the Asio networking backend.

options.name: FO_DISABLE_WEB_SOCKETS
options.description: Disable WebSocket transport support.

options.name: FO_DISABLE_NAMESPACE
options.description: Compile engine native symbols without the FOnline namespace.

options.name: FO_DISABLE_VULKAN
options.description: Disable the Vulkan rendering backend.

options.name: FO_DISABLE_SDL_GPU
options.description: Disable the SDL_GPU rendering backend.

options.name: FO_VERBOSE_BUILD
options.description: Enable verbose FOnline build-system status output.

options.name: FO_BUILD_CLIENT
options.description: Generate client application targets.

options.name: FO_BUILD_SERVER
options.description: Generate server application targets.

options.name: FO_BUILD_MAPPER
options.description: Generate mapper application targets.

options.name: FO_BUILD_ASCOMPILER
options.description: Generate the AngelScript compiler application target.

options.name: FO_BUILD_BAKER
options.description: Generate baker application targets.

options.name: FO_UNIT_TESTS
options.description: Generate engine unit-test targets.

options.name: FO_CODE_COVERAGE
options.description: Generate the code-coverage configuration; this mode cannot be combined with application or unit-test build modes.

stages.name: Init
stages.description: Declare options, detect the platform/toolchain, and establish common build state.

stages.name: ProjectOptions
stages.description: Normalize project option combinations and reject incompatible build modes.

stages.name: ThirdParty
stages.description: Register bundled third-party dependencies and package lookup isolation.

stages.name: EngineSources
stages.description: Aggregate engine and embedding-project source lists and generated resource inputs.

stages.name: Codegen
stages.description: Define generated metadata/source outputs and code-generation targets.

stages.name: CoreLibs
stages.description: Create reusable engine libraries from the registered source groups.

stages.name: Applications
stages.description: Create enabled client, server, mapper, compiler, baker, viewer, and test applications.

stages.name: ScriptsAndBaking
stages.description: Create script compilation and resource baking targets.

stages.name: Packages
stages.description: Create package targets from embedding-project package declarations.

stages.name: Finalize
stages.description: Finalize target organization and verify that every stage ran exactly once.

helpers.name: SetOption
helpers.description: Set an embedding-project default only when the variable is not already defined.

helpers.name: AddStageHook
helpers.description: Register a project macro at a stage boundary before that stage executes.

helpers.name: RegisterFindPackageHandler
helpers.description: Register the explicit package lookup handler used by the ThirdParty-stage find_package interceptor.

helpers.name: AddEngineSources
helpers.description: Add role-scoped embedding-project native sources before RegisterEngineSources.

helpers.name: AddNativeIncludeDir
helpers.description: Add project-relative include directories when Native scripting is enabled.

helpers.name: AddBakingTarget
helpers.description: Create a project baking target with an optional subconfig, force mode, and build-hash update after SetupScriptsAndBaking.
